verdict.rationale: Vapi documents OpenAI-style function calling: custom webhook-based Function Tools send a `tool-calls` message to your Server URL during the call, for actions such as looking up a customer record or booking an appointment. That covers calling external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation. The evidence does not show how the assistant fills the wait while a tool runs or speaks the result back. Idle messages and the latency docs cover user inactivity and model speed, not tool latency. Missing for 10: documented filler/acknowledgement messages during tool execution, explicit handling of how tool results are spoken back, independent or hands-on corroboration of low-latency tool calls.
